title: dayroyo Aziz
source_text:
Qamayto kibi dәmšalnux, domaṇṇo, kibux maḥkatlan ʕal ruḥux? 
Yani ʕal aḥ+ḥayayḏux? 
Mayko hat, әšmux, aḥ+ḥaye dmašfaʕlux yani bări muʕdo, me neʕmuṯux ládyawma?
Dayroyo ʕAziz: Ono dayroyo ʕAzíz Ḥawšab mi+Xarabale d̥kәmmila Arkaḥ. 
Bu+lišono uʕdo u+xabrano karәx, bәṯr zabne mīr qәryo hawxa, bas mu+zabno d Mor Malax, aqdam alfo ŭ šwaʕmo+әšne, mimárwayla Arkaḥ, xud waláyewa, kə́twayla malko әšme Wáhban ste.
Mawladno alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ tmone ŭ әšti b Arkaḥ, ŭ bač+čaʕ ŭ šawʕi mkameli i+madrašto šarwayto du+turkoyo. 
Bәṯr sәmli af+fulḥone di+qriṯo, šuġlone di+qriṯo, du+bayto. 
Bu+ṭuro šġili bann+arʕoṯo, sәmli ruʕyuṯo kmo+әšne. 
Mәd aṯyo i+folḥuṯo, azzino li+folḥuṯo, sәmli tmonaʕ̥ṣar+yarḥe ʕaskariye.
Ŭ aṯino bu+yarḥo da+ḥdaʕ̥ṣar, ḥḏo ŭ tәšʕi li+dayro b̥fәkәr d̥oweno dayroyo. 
Ŭ bi+ṭaybuṯo d Aloho hawi naṣī́b hawxa, bann+arbaʕ ŭ tәšʕi hawino dayroyo, tralfo ŭ tarte — kohno, mi+naqqayo hul uʕdo kalí hárkeno bi+dayro.
Ilyas. 
Naʕm. 
Aḥ+ḥaye di+dayroyuṯo áydarbone, Abuna? 
Yani, mәn šәkl, dәmmina, áydarbo kobodat, ṣafro koqaymat, hul ʕaṣriye aḥ+ḥaye, u+tempo du+yawmo kule, áydarbo kofoyat?
Hano kito ann+arbʕo mawsime, šuḥlofe di+šato, mšáḥlfene harke gabayna bu+aṯro. 
Kul+šuḥlofo k̬mamṭe ʕam ruḥe šәkl d̥fәlḥono. 
Bas aḥna, bu zoyudo u+zabnayḏan k̬mašfʕínale bu+fulḥono du+karmo di+ganṯo, ŭ ksoḥo, ŭ floḥo, ŭ mṭoyo daf+fire, ŭ hawxa bu+šәklano.
Bas kə́tlanste, bay+yarḥe du+qayṭo kobina hәrge du+suryoyo, kowelan yolufe kul+naqqa, arbʕo+ḥamšo+yolufe, dәkfayši dayәm harke. 
Ŭ uʕdo kuzzə́n bi+dane d̥ṣafrayto lu+maktab di+dawla lu+turkoyo. 
Ŭ bi+dane dʕaṣríyeste d̥koṯәn, dhowalle zabno, dlówalle hәrge du+maktab, du+beṯsefro turkoyo, komaqrәnne suryoyo.
Ṣafrayto gәmṣalina i+saʕa bann+arbaʕ ŭ falge, qaymi uxlәnne fako ŭ kuzzə́n lu+maktab. 
I+saʕa bat+tarte, mede hawxa koṯәn, disa kuxli, ŭ xud mәḷḷi bi+dane dʕaṣriye fulḥone ġēr dlowelan, komaqrénanne.
I+saʕa ba+ḥdaʕ̥ṣar ŭ falge kәmṣalina i+ṣluṯo d̥falge dyawmo ʕam ḥḏoḏe disa, aʕ+ʕomure di+dayro. 
Ŭ i+saʕa bann+arbaʕ dʕaṣríyeste ṣluṯo dramšo kәmṣalina. 
Ŭ bәṯr mi+ṣluṯo dramšo kuxlina muklo, ŭ hawxa. 
Aḥ+ḥaye yawmonoye di+dayro kibi domaṇṇo uʕdo zabnonoʔíṯ háwxayo.
 Naʕm. 
Kibux maḥkatli, Abuna, ʕal aḥ+ḥaye di+dayro, yani, u+tarī̀x, u+maktàbzabno di+dayro?
Hiya, i+dayro d Mor Malke… aṯi bu+doro da+tloṯo Mor Malke ŭ Mor Awgín me Mәṣәr larke, ʕald̥ kәtyo Mor Malke u+xwarz d Mor Awgín. 
Mor Awgín u+ḥolo d Mor Málke yo.
Ínaqqa d aṯәn me Mәṣәr mṭalle tre ŭ šawʕi+talmiḏe, aṯәn ʕam Mor Awgín ŭ Mor Malke. 
Ele sәmle dayroyo lu+ḥolo, ŭ howewa gabe.
Komar, naqlawat nofaqwa mi+dayro, koraxwa bu+ṭuro. 
Komar yawmo aṯi larke, ldukṯa di+dayro. 
Ŭ dukṯa di+dayro disa dáyrowe, maʕbad daṣ+ṣalme, ṣuġḏiwa li+šәmšo.
Bas ḥaríwowe, xud̥‿ḥarbe kәtwa harke. 
Ḥәḷḷe, kīt tre+tloṯo+yolufe kanné k̬boxәn, azzé, mqadamle laff elayye, mәḷḷe, 'Mәn hawi aʕmayxu, qay k̬boxitu?
'
Mәrre, ' Kə́twaylan ḥawro, әmmina "Slaq li+tenaṯe, mәdlan tene!" 
Salәq li+teno... axile... dmōd tene dobelan. 
Nafәq k̇urk̇odī́l, zәhá mi+mʕarṯaṯe, blәʕle ŭ axile u+ḥawrayḏan. 
Ánnaqa lo+kuḏʕina mә‿g̊saymina '.
Hánoste, u+abro d Wahban, әšme Šleymun, ṭalyo, Šleymun, u+abro d Wahban, u+malko d Árkaḥ we. 
'Uʕdo dәzzán li+qriṯo, mә‿gdәmmina lu+babo? 
Lo+kuḏʕina'. 
Komar, Mor Malke darḥal aḏәʕ d̥ḥaylo ṣoṭonóyoyo, layto mede ṭabiʕi, yani, xud̥‿kurfo daxila.
Lu+šiḏo sәmle ruḥe hawxa. 
Mṣalele ŭ mʔamaḷḷe ʕal u+šiḏo, mәḷḷe, 'K̬lozam mәfqat u+ṭalyo dlowe ebe múmoste. 
Latlux daṣṭәr li+xaliqa d Aloho mʕaḏbatla'. 
Komar ḥfәxle u+ṭalyo sāġ, ŭ azzә́n ay+yolufe, mәdde lu+ḥawraṯṯe, ŭ azzә́n mәrre lu+malko, 'Hawxa mede ǧari aʕmayna'.
Komar qām u+malko, a+greʕayḏe aṯәn, ḥәrre, kalé Mor Malke hēš kәmṣale harke. 
Mqadámmalle tawdyoṯo, mәrre, 'Mәn k̬lozamlux?
' Mәḷḷe, 'Ánnaqa gmʕawnítuli, gmaʕәmrina bayto lu+šubḥo d Aloho harke'.
Ŭ hawo hawi ṣәbba dmaʕmarre dayro harke. 
Lu+mede d̥kīt kṯiwo tloṯmo ŭ ḥamšaʕ̥ṣar mšanele l Mor Malke.
Naʕm. 
Bәṯr ma+tlaṯmo ŭ ḥamšaʕ̥ṣar, ŭ ládyawma, tralfo ŭ čaʕ̥ṣar, mәn kibux maḥkatlan bu+zabno d̥fayәt? 
Kibux dәmmat, alfo ŭ šwaʕmo+әšne, mәn kibux maḥkat aʕlayye, dәmmat mu+yawmo ládyawma? 
Mәn ǧari bi+dayraṯe?  
Mәn hawi eba?
Hiya, i+dayro qayәm qadiše ġắlăbe eba, qayәm dayroye, kәtlan beṯ qadiše laltaḥ, ḥzallux. 
Ŭ meqәm i+dayroyuṯo kibi domaṇṇo l Mor Awgín mbarbzole ba+d̥koṯani ŭ ʕal íḏeste hēš a+mhaymne dbi+mšiḥoyuṯo lo+kamiliwa harke. 
I+sbarṯo di+mšiḥoyuṯo bat+teḏәmroṯo d̥sәmle l Mor Malke ŭ l Mor Awgín ŭ lat+talmiḏayḏe, mṭalle u+ʕamo li+mšiḥoyuṯo harke.
I+dayro ʕamiro... ʕal d ġắlăbe u+maktàbzabno lo+fāš biḏayna, maḥraw naqqawat ġắlăbe bann+alfo arbaʕmo lu+Tamarlənkse... dәryo, maḥrawwe i+dayro.
Lu+mede dәḥzelan bu+maktàbzabno, bәṯr mәd maʕmro mi+draytayo dann+alfo ŭ arbaʕmo k̬bәdyo dhuyo marʕiṯo lruḥa, komaḷḷa marʕiṯo dBeṯ Riše. 
Tfiqina ʕal әšme d̥ḥamšo ŭ ʕәṣri+ḥsayo ḥa bәṯre ḥa. 
Kul+ḥa mema lema yatu ʕal u+kursi harke, hul alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri, dəryalle.
U+ḥaroyo diḏan kfarzóyowa.
E, ḥasyo Samuel, Šmuel. 
E, hawxa. 
Ŭ tamo bәṯr mәd dәryo, alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri disa kfayšo ḥaruto maš+šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri laḥ+ḥamši, ŭ baḥ+ḥamši k̬bodәn as+suryoye eba hedi-hedi dmaʕәmrila. 
Ḥšaw hul‿luʕdo d̥kamili aʕ+ʕamarat diḏa, yani kibux dәmmat lawyo xud méqәmste. 
Hánoyo, kibi karyoʔíṯ domaṇṇux.
L Timū́r madrówayle, l Timurlénk, alfo ŭ arbaʕmo ŭ ḥammәš…
Alfo ŭ arbaʕmo,  alfo ŭ arbaʕmo…
Ŭ bәṯr mu+zabnawo fayišo nafәlto?
Ánnaqa, e, tamo, lo, k̬maḥwe ġắlăbe lo+fayišo nafәlto. 
Bәṯr kmo+әšne u+mede dәḥzelan bu+maktàbzabno k̬bәdyo ḥasyuṯo harke. 
K̬maḥwe bәṯr mәd maʕәmrәlle markáwwәlla, xud̥ ḥasyuṯo, mdawamla hul laš+šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri, alfo ŭ čaʕmo šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri. 
Mann+alfo ŭ arbaʕmo, alfo ŭ čaʕmo šeṯ… taqriban šeṯmo+әšne hawxa.
Bu+šawṭo grәšla i+dәqqayḏi, Abuna, dmaḥkelux, dmәrlux, Wahban u+malko. 
Maḥkelux, әmmat, u+malko di+Xarabàlewa. 
I+Xarabale kibux mәn dәmmat aʕla, maḥkatlan?
E, hiya i+naqqayo komar kәtwa eba ʕaṣralfo+bote. 
Yani xәd walaye rábṯowa.  
Ŭ kәtwa yani hani dәmmina  ʕaṣralfo+bote me ʕṣar dәmmat mo+alfo+nufus, taqriban dәmmina. 
Yani xәd walaye rábṯowa. 
Ŭ kə́twaste ḥeḏora disa xәd‿әmmat qәryawoṯo naʕime maṣre bu+malko. 
I+naqqayo ġắlăbe maʔ+ʔaṯrowoṯo dәbriṯo hawxa midabriwa xәd‿әmmat, ʕayalat naʕime, háwxawa i+naqqayo i+dabara dәbriṯo.
Naʕm. 
Hano mayna doro komәǧġolat, Abuna? 
Hayna dóroyo hano?
E, bu+doro da+tloṯo, dann+arbʕo, hawxa.
Mu+zabnawo ládyawma mә‿kibux maḥkatli ʕal i+Xarabale? 
Yani mu+doro da+tloṯo ŭ ládyawma?
E, xud mәḷḷi i+Xarabale hiya lo+fāš tarī́x biḏayna, a+kṯowe kulle yaqiḏi ŭ maḥәrwi ŭ gniwi ŭ mṣakri. 
E, ḥa max+xabre d̥kәmmila Xarabé Alé, Xarabale, aw Ḥarbaṯ Ayle d̥fayišo zabne ŭ dore ḥaruto, xlíṯoyo, yani. 
Mawxa mə́rralla Xarabé Alé, Ḥarbaṯ Ayle.
Ŭ hiya u+mede dmaḥkele lǧәddi, ḥzeli ono ǧәddi, omar, 'Ono bu+zabnayḏi muqḏolle tloṯ+naqqat, a+tlaṯ kore maʕәmrolan'. 
Kuḏʕat, meqәm aq+qәryawoṯo mišakliwa me quwerәš. 
U+qarәš, kefe našife dlo čimәnto, maqimiwa arbʕo+šurone ŭ quṭríwanne b̥qayse, veya iḏa rwíḥoyo hәnna maš+šurone, maḥtiwa stuwan bu+falgo du+bayto, quṭríwanne.
Stuwan bu+falgo?
E, ŭ mi+xaṣrayo layo.
 Šuro bu+falgo?
Lo, lo, šure lowewa bu+falgo, lo.
Naʕm. 
Šure bas bag+gabe?
Mi+xaṣrayo ŭ layo mḥalqiwa mi+stunayo layo, lu+syoġawo.. 
mu+syoġawo lawo, howewa qarәš. 
Háwxawayne ab+bote. 
Ono maṭino lu+šәklawo, i+qriṯo falga hēš hawxa.
Ŭ hiye baḥ+ḥammәš ŭ ḥamšiyat, bu+waxtawo bdele d̥owele... ḥāl dan+noše, cik̇e dhowalle madiye, daʕәr ruḥo appe әšmo mu+Sayfo... dlatimi... Bdalle dorәn aq+quwerәšanәk, ḥәfri ŭ maʕәmqi at+tamale daq+quwerәšanәk, malḥqәnne li+šeno, maqimi bote b̥kefe ŭ kalšo, kәmmínanne quṣre, qṭore hawxa.
Naʕm. 
Yani u+tarī̀x di+Xarabale mu+doro da+tloṯo ŭ bәṯr, qamayto wálayewa, bәṯr mi+walaye mәn ǧari, hawi? 
Dәmmina ag+ged̥še ŭ am+maktàbzabne dәḥzalxu ʕal i+Xarabale, mәn hawi eba?
E, hiya, xәd mәḷḷi harke… kәtwa tre+ḥayle rabe bәbriṯo i+naqqayo, be áydarbo uʕdo kīt Rusya ŭ ʕAmáriqa, i+naqqàyoste af+fәrsoye ŭ ay+yawnòyewayne. 
Ŭ harke kul+naqla a+tre+ḥaylani harke bu+xṭuṭano qayṯiwa bәḥḏoḏe, ŭ harke midošiwa.
Máwxaste layt mede iṯbā́t mo bam+mo biḏayna Arkaḥ mәn ǧarila, kul+doro, ema, mәn, mәqqa ḥariwo. 
Bas kšobah daxila ḏarbe ġắlăbe naqqawat mi+sәbbaṯe. 
Kibi hawxa domaṇṇo, mede zәd̥ṫə́r lo+koḏaʕno.
Dínaqqa dәmmina bu+doro daʕ+ʕaṣro, da+traʕ̥ṣar, daḥ+ḥamšaʕ̥ṣar  lә+kḥozutu mede, maktábzabno ʕal i+Xarabale? 
Yani mәn komaḥwo, qriṯo komaḥwo, walaye komaḥwo, ḥasyuṯo komaḥwo?
E, lo, xud mәḷḷi k̬bәdyo i+ḥasyuṯo harke bas lo b Arkaḥ ŭ bas, komaḷḷa marʕiṯo dBeṯ Riše, swaʕ̥+qәrywoṯo das+suryoye ḥeḏora, maṣre b Árkaḥ wayne, ŭ mdabárwalle u+ḥasyo. 
Marʕiṯo dBeṯ Riše mə́rralla, hawxa kuḏʕina mede zәd̥ṫə́r — lo. 
Layto kṯiwo, ġēr mede layt.
Abuna, mәn kibux maḥkatlan ʕal u+zabno, dәmmina, dbări muʕdo b̚mo+әšne? 
Dәmmina, du+waxt d̥ Ḥaǧo, alfo ŭ čaʕmo әšto ŭ ʕәṣri? 
Aw dínaqla du+Sayfo mәn ǧari dәmmina bi+Xarabale ŭ ʕal Mor Malke? 
Mәn hawi?
Hiye ínaqqa du+Sayfo d̥šamәʕ u+ʕamo kané quṭli a+mšiḥoye, bdalle dәmtaksi harke ruḥayye. 
Dis‿latimi aq+qәryawoṯo d̥ḥeḏәr i+dayro, kulle mṭalle an+naʕime ŭ as+sowe ŭ an+neše larke, ŭ bdalle dәmmina b Badәbbe ŭ bi+xaṣrayo d̥kolәn, mdafʕi ruḥayye. 
Ŭ bi+sәbba dhawiwa šayno b ʕIwardo, ʕal iḏe d̥šēx Fatḥәlla kaliwa u+ḥarb, harke ġắlăbe lo+mqatal  ʕal… lawi qrobo baq+qәryawoṯani.
Hawi taxtuše naʕime, bas qrobo dәmmat dmәqṭәl‿nsane ġắlăbe lawi, elo mallesef mi+balangaziye ŭ mu+kafno mәd latwa malḥo u+ʕamo kayule, māṯ noše ġắlăbe harke bi+dayro. 
Heš kelə́n aq+qawraṯṯe tamo láltaḥste.
Hano bu+Sayfo kowe. 
Bas kito Ḥaǧo bәṯr mәnne ʕ̥ṣar+әšne.
E, Ḥaǧo, e, Ḥaǧo dәmmina hawo komaḷḷe u+isyā̀n d ʕAlik̇é Baṭe, ʕam ḥḏoḏe, ḥáwronewayne. 
Hano qayәm dәmmina bәṯr mәd rakiwo i+ǧumhurìyeste, ḥammәš ŭ ʕәṣri, šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri, qayimi mqabәl di+dawla. 
Ŭ dәmmina hano mawfaqle aʕ+ʕomure di+dayro, bdele dmәstaʕmal i+dayro xud̥‿qalʕo mqabәl di+dawla.
Ŭ zbiṭole, zbiṭole, šamiʕo i+dawla, aṯyo i+ʕaskariye me lalʕal, mi+xaṣra d Dyarbakәr, šamiʕi dharke kowe. 
Mәd̥‿šamәʕ d̥kaṯyo i+ʕaskariye lo+qadәr zobaṭ ruḥe, mahzamle. 
Ŭ aṯәn, aṯyo i+ʕaskar, drela i+dayro, әmmo, 'Naqqa ḥreto', әmmo, 'dlo+yәtwi eba'. 
Baš+šeṯ ŭ ʕәṣri.
Naʕm. 
Hiye foyašwa harke.
E, fāšwa harke.
Kәtlux kṯowo, Abuna, ʕal u+maktàbzabno di+dayro, ʕal i+marduṯo d̥arke, ʕal ag+gelone di+dukṯo, ʕal aḥ+ḥaye d̥arke kәtlux kṯowo. 
Mәn kibux bәqfisuṯo dәmmina maḥkatlan ʕal u+kṯowawo? 
Mәn ḥzelux, dәmmina, kibux maḥkatli ʕal u+fulḥono di+dayro? 
Yani u+fulḥono dәmmina bgawa di+dayro, dәmmina mәn kozәrʕutu? 
Mәn koḥәṣdutu? 
Mәn kokәsḥutu? 
Yani kәtxu medone harke, ʕal mәn koʕayšutu aḥ+ḥayaṯxu? 
Bi+aġlabiye mәn kosaymutu? 
Fәlḥone dlarwal mi+dayro dәmmina, karmo kәtlux, aw fәstaq kәtlux, aw sato kәtlux, mәn kәtlux medone hawxa d̥kozәrʕutu aw d̥koḥәṣdutu?
Hiye harke aḥna xud zād lo+k̬zәrʕina tә+mede bas ilone daf+fire ksaymina. 
Ŭ kul+àṯroste, šәkl dilone kibe dʕoyaš ebe, kul+ilono b̥kul+aṯro lo+kowe. 
E, harke bi+ganṯayḏan kәtlan kibe ʕaṣro+šәklat dʕәnwe, tene ŭ remune, ŭ mәšmәš, fәstaq, ŭ zaytune. 
Ŭ kito hani xə́rmaste bas hanәk kmaštínanne ġắlăbe, dlo lo+kowәn. 
Ŭ hani, ilone di+dukṯo kәtlan bi+ganṯo.
Ŭ u+kṯowo d̥sәmli, i+sәbba du+kṯowo d̥sәmli, ono ʕal d̥sәmli xәd mәḷḷi kmo+әšne ruʕyuṯo baṭ+ṭuronàniste. 
Kuḏʕat kul+qriṯo kәtte әšmóneste laṭ+ṭurone di+qriṯayo, kәbʕat diḏan kәbʕat ġēr me diḏan.
Mšayálwayno uʕdo, bu+zabnano kәmšālno ar+ruʕye ʕlayme, komaṇṇo 'Ayko marʕatwa ádyawma?
' Komar, 'Lo+koḏaʕno mә‿kәmmi ltamo'. 
Ŭ ono koḏaʕno әšme daṭ+ṭurone di+qriṯo kulle. 
Ánnaqqa ḥәḷḷi, omaṇṇo 'Ašə́r aḥna dәzzan du+generasyonano diḏan dmәnqolina mi+arʕaṯe gmәṭʕәn a+d̥koṯani kulle'. 
Yani hano ḥḏo mas+sәbbat... dhawi sәbba d̥koṯawno u+kṯowo.
Dat+tàrteste u+meditìz yani ad+darmone dann+osawoṯo dәbriṯo kulle kmisomi mag+gelone áġlaba.

ḥzeli ǧəddiste b Arkaḥ, maṭino lǧəddiste b Arkaḥ.
